p2_b3.ocr: an = 148 bn = 71 cn = 77 doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0124211.t002 HRQOL of mild and moderately active UC The mean ± SD IBDQ total scores of patients with mild and moderate UC were 156.20±24.99 and 143.94±28.10, respectively (Table 3); the patients with moderate UC had a significantly lower total score compared with the patients with mild UC (P = 0.001). The moderate patients’ mean or median of four domains was also significantly lower than the patients with mild UC (P<0.05), especially with respect to the bowel symptoms domain (P = 0.001).
